name: scala-cqrs-es-rules

options.generatedBy: string — the `@generated by <stamp>` header line (date fallback when omitted; mirrors the hardcoded rules_domain_gen stamp and never participates in comparisons).
options.elementHashes: object — knowledge-side sidecar { noteId: hash } (a slice of the graph export elementHashes); drives the @knowledge <uuid>@<hash> anchor suffix in Behaviors case anchors, RuleParams class anchors and the Rules/Spec per-rule anchors. Missing entry → bare @knowledge <uuid>.

description: Rules face: the rules_domain_gen pass that overwrites the aggregate behaviors glue (CommandHelpers; Behaviors command-flow wiring with port injection; RuleParams projection VOs; Rules invariant object with the exprToScala engine; RulesSpec pure-domain suite driven by executable_cases) with semantically-derived output. Byte-identical to live rules_domain_gen; consumes the canonical augmented by tools/augment-rules-canonical.mjs.
